note: v1, written - the first round. KEPT IN MERCURY: delay-line memory. ONE 16-bit word (the melody, on an FM chime) is written once and then only recirculates round a one-bar ping-pong feedback line (0.78) through a worn tape and a grain cloud; each bar a few bits flip at a climbing error rate (A 0 -> 0.10, C 0.02 -> 0.14, D 0.25) and at the REFRESH (the tape stops, the Juno pads freeze) the word is rebuilt by a majority vote of its last four passes - the tune drifts by decay and repair. Every pitch is an absolute frequency on a STRETCHED OCTAVE (1210 cents; four single-voice pad tracks, since frequencies can't stack in a chord token). 909 + 808 with seeded chance hats and a Euclidean (5,16) rim; the outro is the line alone.
